notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Saprolings.
description:
Cast Sprout Swarm, paying {3} for the buyback.
Mana Echoes triggers as the Saproling token ETBs, adding colorless mana equal to the number of Saprolings you control.
Spend the mana to cast Sprout Swarm again, convoking the new Saproling token to pay the colored mana cost.
